label: PF Backlog 627
title: Dynamic/runtime agents: auto-register on creation + fail-closed resolution for unknown agents
body: Dynamic agent creation (review_ledger.create_agent / agent_spec.save_spec) must register the agent in config/agent-registry/index.json (single writer, with outputs). Runtime resolution must fail-closed/record when an agent is unknown (not silently skip validation).
